groups.sentence: Instructors may allow or use AI for study aids, practice problems and practice exams, and students may use it for self-study.
Students may use AI to generate practice questions, quizzes, flashcards or self-tests, and are encouraged to do so to support their learning.
Students may use AI to create study guides, summaries and other study aids from their notes or course materials.
Students may use AI as a tutor, study partner or role-play partner to rehearse skills, interviews, presentations and likely questions.
Students may use AI for general studying, exam preparation, reviewing concepts and preparing for assignments.
AI is commonly used for self-quizzing, study guides, practice and supplemental learning, and can increase practice.
Students may use AI to plan their studying, such as study schedules, work plans, checklists and organized notes.
Students may not use generative AI to develop their understanding of a concept.
Students may use AI for study only when the output is practice material and is not submitted as graded work.
